input.description: Main-shaft angle about +Z driving the gearbox (8T 0/85/124 on the 24T input gear)

shift.description: Catch-1 (0/90/66) angle about +Z: k*pi/2 selects gear k+1; the shaft turns pi/2 per paddle stroke

paddle.description: Paddle rocker angle about +Y at (140,-260); negative = paddle at x=180 pulled

phase_stage1.description: Carry offset of the stage-1 output shafts, keyed at ratio changes

phase_stage2.description: Carry offset of the output shaft group, keyed at ratio changes

notes: Source: data/models-annotated/42083-1.mpd (Philippe Hurbain [Philo], CCAL 2.0), section '42083 - chiron.ldr', unmodified. Standalone extract written by scripts/extract_subsystem.py --section in the same frame (LDU, -Y up, front -Z, car's left +X); motion authored on source IDs and remapped (source/idmap.json).
Ratios, signs, pivots and link lengths are measured from library connector frames by scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py; embedded DATs use their library part's frames for analysis only.
Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.

RECONSTRUCTION: two 12T double-bevel gears (32270) absent from the source are added to this extract only: on shaft 0/90/53 at (80,0,40) meshing 20T clutch 0/90/84, and on shaft 0/90/30 at (-80,-40,160) meshing 20T 0/90/13. Evidence: the official inventory lists 8 such gears, the file has 6; both 20T gears and shaft 0/90/30 otherwise have no partner; with them the measured trains give eight decreasing ratios.

Rotary-catch ring travel uses an assumed dwell profile (10 LDU x sat(cos/sin)); the lobe direction is measured (source ring 0/90/57 at -10). The source leaves ring 0/90/54 centred although catch 1 holds it at -10 in 1st gear; the rig shows the cam position.
The carry (catch 2 steps pi/2 once per catch-1 revolution) is timed from the crank geometry and modelled as a linear transfer over the 4th->5th shift; the detent rocker 0/90/149 stays static.
Paddle pawls keep their tips on the ratchet roller circle while driving and lift off otherwise; the detent completing each 90 deg step is assumed. Rubber bands are static context.

stage1.label: Stage 1: four ratios on rings 0/90/54 / 0/90/55 (catch 1)
stage1.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

stage2.label: Stage 2: high/low on rings 0/90/57 / 0/90/56 (catch 2) and the idler chain
stage2.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

shifting.label: Rotary catches, knob wheels and the carry crank
notes: Carry crank towball 0/90/155 at 20.0 LDU, 135 deg about the knob shaft; it faces catch 2 (180 deg) when catch 1 reaches 7pi/4: the carry is modelled over catch 1 = 3pi/2..2pi (mod 2pi)
shifting.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

paddles.label: Paddle rocker, pawls and ratchet
notes: Ratchet 1/193/23 turns -1 x catch 1 about +Y (two 4-knob right angles)
Pawl l: arm 83.85 LDU, tip radius 24.65 LDU, drives on paddle -0.3 side
Pawl r: arm 83.85 LDU, tip radius 24.65 LDU, drives on paddle +0.3 side
Pawl tips ride the ratchet rollers (radius 24.65 LDU about the ratchet axis) on the driving stroke only; full stroke 0.6 rad sweeps 69.3 deg, the stepper detent completes the 90 deg step (assumed)
paddles.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

interfaces.label: Main shaft (8T 0/85/124) driving the gearbox input (from the drivetrain extract)
interfaces.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

mounting_frame.label: Mounting frame and context (static)
mounting_frame.review: Static by decision: supports, bearings, latches and context parts selected around the moving mechanism (keep.json). The rest of the car is absent from this extract.
